This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The 
first draft initiated by eng. وجدي رشدي حبيب، تم اختباره بواسطة المهندس. 
سامي شحاتة، قبول م. Hany Fahmy Madny; 
general manager, 
approved by eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic 
Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC quality control 
general director, and MPIS Coordinator.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

فحص الزيت الموجود في 
تحمل الآلة والمحرك.

Adjust the machine oil 
level or change it if necessary.

Adjust the motor bearing 
oil level if necessary.

فحص الفرامل و 
قم بتغيير أحذية الفرامل إذا لزم الأمر.

Clean the machine parts 
and its items from outside.

دهن أجزاء الآلة

oil it.
Check up the doors.

the cabinet.

Operate the elevator with 
full load and readjust the stopping of the cabinet in the floors.

sections_en.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Wagdi Rushdi Habib, tested by Eng. 
Sami Shehata, accepted by Eng. Hany Fahmy Madny; 
general manager, 
approved by eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic 
Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC quality control 
general director, and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety precautions

A 
work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Wear safety and health equipment such as the helmet, 
safety shoes, etc.
Stop the lift and switch off the power supply.
Stop the lift and switch off the power supply.

sections_en.text: Work to be carried out

Check the oil in the 
bearings of the machine and the motor.

Adjust the machine oil 
level or change it if necessary.

Adjust the motor bearing 
oil level if necessary.

Inspect the brakes and 
replace the brake shoes if necessary.

Clean the machine parts 
and its items from outside.

Lubricate the machine parts 
and the sheave machine room.

Clean the cabin guides and 
oil it.
Check up the doors.

Check up the rope belts on 
the cabinet.

Check that the car stops 
at all levels.

Operate the elevator with 
full load and readjust the stopping of the cabinet in the floors.
